mapping.name: Jamal the Black Spear
mapping.personality_traits: Always faces east when sharpening his sword. Attached to his prayer charms. Believes the sky keeps men sane.
mapping.ideals: Code of Honor. Hospitality is sacred. Never break your word.
mapping.bonds: Fascinated by history. Keeps tiny packets of desert salt to throw at evil spirits.
mapping.flaws: Honesty - must obey the law. Guilt Complex. Selfless.
mapping.backstory:
Months ago, you swore your blade to protect a wealthy caravan master of Al Shihr as
his wagons crossed the burning deserts beyond the Empty Quarter. But beneath a moonless sky, raiders
descended upon the caravan with fire and arrows, and though you slew many, too many innocents died
screaming in the dark while you still drew breath.

Ever since, shame has followed you like a second shadow. You now wander, praying that you can find
wealth enough to repay the ruined merchant and restore the honor you believe you forfeited upon the
sands that terrible night.

mapping.name: Farah the Fireborn
mapping.personality_traits: Secretly fears deep water. Laughs quietly whenever danger becomes especially severe. Keeps meticulous records of debts, favors, and insults. Collects expensive perfumes from every city she visits.
mapping.ideals: Comfortable Wealth. Starting wealth is twice normal.
mapping.bonds: Deeply vain about her hair. Mistaken Identity - someone important thinks she is someone else.
mapping.backstory:
You were born to wealth in the courts of Persia, but found luxury far less exciting
than danger, treasure, and forbidden magic.

Fire has always fascinated you, and now you wield flame and shamshir with equal skill, delighting in the
terror both inspire. Unfortunately, reckless expeditions and extravagant living have nearly ruined you,
and you desperately need a treasure worthy of your reputation. The legends of treasure-laden islands in
the Arabian Sea burn in your thoughts like living embers.

Worse still, your beauty and noble bearing constantly cause strangers to mistake you for the Princess of
Persia... a misunderstanding you rarely correct when it proves useful.

mapping.name: Ibn al-Aswad
mapping.personality_traits: Always looking for the angle. Quick with a knife and quicker with a lie.
mapping.ideals: Freedom. Everyone should be free to live as they choose.
mapping.bonds: Owes a debt to a powerful merchant prince.
mapping.flaws: Greed. Cannot resist a valuable target.
mapping.backstory:
You grew up sleeping beneath market stalls, surviving through charm, quick feet, and
fast fingers. One evening, while fleeing palace guards across the rooftops, you accidentally stumbled
into the chambers of the infamous Indian sorcerer SANGTARASH the Gem-maker. There you discovered the
Djellaba of Fate, a magnificent robe stitched with impossible patterns said to twist luck itself around
its wearer. You stole it immediately, of course, though not before accidentally setting the wizard's
beard on fire and escaping through a window three stories above the street. Since then, fortune seems
strangely drawn to you, and you've spent most of your days gambling, flirting, and outrunning the man
who would very much like his magical robe returned.

mapping.personality_traits: Compassionate and devout. Sees the divine in all things.
mapping.ideals: Faith. The gods work through us.
mapping.bonds: Devoted to healing the sick and protecting the innocent.
mapping.backstory:
As a Bedouin, you have lived your whole life with your family in the desert, but you
think that life is cursed. Your sheep died, poisoned by what can only be a genie's curse. Your brother
fell ill, and has strange blue fingers now. Even your bow, which has saved your life on a dozen
occasions, works against you, snapping at the most inopportune times. Fortunately, Allah must have been
watching, as a group of travelers frightened away that jackal pack just as the dogs had you surrounded.
Your people believe strongly that one honorable favor deserves another, so you agreed to safely
accompany them to the ports of Al-Shihr.

mapping.name: Palmtree the Pirate
mapping.personality_traits: Loud, boisterous, and loves a good fight. Never turns down a drink or a dare.
mapping.ideals: Loyalty. A pirate's word is their bond.
mapping.bonds: Sworn to find the legendary White Shark's treasure.
mapping.backstory:
You came to the island on a small dhow, hoping to get a share of the White Shark of
Basra's great treasure - a man you sailed with 10 years ago for a short time. But all that you got was
horror.

First, a giant killed your friends. Then you were chased by horrible hyena creatures with intelligent
eyes. Finally, you found a hiding place, but for the last two nights you've been haunted by nightmares
of a Chain Ghast, a cloaked, ghost-like spectre who whips you with chains before vanishing again. Now,
you've lost all hope of escaping this cursed palace...!

**Backup Character!** — he is also the survivor the party finds in @[A Terrified Survivor](entity:location/A Terrified Survivor);
see @[Hassan "Palmtree" Al-Bahr](entity:npc/Hassan "Palmtree" Al-Bahr).

mapping.name: Qasim the Digitologist
mapping.personality_traits: Obsessed with numerical patterns. Speaks in equations when excited.
mapping.ideals: Knowledge. The universe is a puzzle to be solved.
mapping.bonds: Searching for the lost mathematical proofs of the ancients.
mapping.flaws: Absent-minded. Forgets practical matters while lost in thought.
mapping.backstory:
You belong to the secretive Guild of Digitologists, a brotherhood who believes all
magic is merely hidden mathematics written into the bones of the world. Before casting even the simplest
spell, you mutter geometric proofs beneath your breath, sketch numerals in the air, and calculate
celestial ratios like a scholar balancing an impossible equation. Unfortunately, you apply that same
confidence to games of chance. Three times now you have lost your fortune in the gambling dens after
convincing yourself you had discovered patterns hidden within dice throws and card draws. You now seek a
new source of incoming... because your debts are once again multiplying faster than you can subtract
them.

mapping.name: The Owl
mapping.personality_traits: Speaks little, observes everything. Moves like a shadow.
mapping.bonds: Tracks a rare creature that once saved her life.
mapping.flaws: Solitary. Struggles in crowds and cities.
mapping.backstory:
For many years you were the unwilling servant of a cruel sorcerer who hid his face
behind silk veils and commanded spirits whose names should never be spoken aloud. You fought his
enemies, guarded his chambers, and watched innocent people vanish into his experiments. When you
finally escaped, the sorcerer laid a curse upon you: if you ever reveal your true name or face, death
will swiftly find you. Now you wander beneath cloak and bronze mask, your old identity buried like a
corpse beneath the dunes. In the port city of Al Shihr you have become a quiet protector of the
desperate and forgotten, taking coin only from those who can afford it and offering your sword freely
to those who cannot.
